in_sanskrit.name: शिवमंगल
in_sanskrit.meaning: Shiva (god of destruction and regeneration) + Mangal (auspiciousness)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings Shiva (god of destruction and regeneration) and Mangal (auspiciousness) together.

in_hindi.name: शिवमंगल
in_hindi.long_meaning: शिव (Shiva) और मंगल (Mangalam) के साथ संघोटना

in_marathi.name: Shivmangal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's Auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivmangal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shivmangal is a combination of two words. Shiva, meaning 'The God of Destruction' and Mangal, meaning 'Fortune' or 'Auspiciousness'. This name signifies the presence of Lord Shiva, who is believed to bring prosperity and protection in one's life.
